revision_policy: Changes require a version bump, claim-ledger reconciliation, and review through the owning section issue. Issue #47 may supersede the working title and abstract only after the complete body is coherent.

identity.working_title: Antidote: A Governed Framework for Inspectable Person-and-Moment Generative Audio Journeys
identity.subtitle: Design and Feasibility Protocol
identity.paper_type: design-science and systems paper with a prospective N-of-1 feasibility protocol
primary_audiences: personal informatics and digital health researchers
identity.clinical_position: research instrument; not a treatment, diagnostic, medical device, or validated digital therapeutic

thesis.statement: Person-and-moment generative audio becomes scientifically testable only when the transformation from consented context and explicit semantic intent through a time-indexed journey plan, generated acoustic realization, actual exposure, separated response measures, and any advisory within-person update is preserved as distinct, inspectable, provenance-linked records.
thesis.establishes_now: The design/protocol manuscript formalizes this research-instrument contract, grounds its components in prior work, describes the implemented and proposed boundaries honestly, and specifies how later feasibility evidence may be collected and interpreted.
thesis.does_not_establish: The manuscript does not establish novelty of the individual components, learnability of a personal mapping, successful affect regulation, therapeutic benefit, clinical safety, or a neurological mechanism.

research_questions.question: How can a local research instrument represent, generate, and evaluate a person-and-moment audio journey while keeping consented context, semantic intent, planned controls, realized acoustics, exposure, response, and longitudinal updates inspectable and non-interchangeable?
research_questions.answer_boundary: Answered through the governed model, architecture, prototype status, and protocol; no human benefit is inferred.

research_questions.question: Can the implemented instrument preserve its declared authority, provenance, control-adherence, continuity, interruption, and recovery contracts across a complete local session?
research_questions.answer_boundary: Technical evidence may enter only after the applicable MVP gate is complete and the claim ledger approves promotion.

research_questions.question: Across repeated sessions, do provenance-linked person-and-moment records support useful advisory relationships among semantic intent, acoustic realization, and self-reported response without increasing burden, surprise, mismatch, or harm?
research_questions.answer_boundary: Requires a frozen protocol, resolved ethics and privacy gates, qualifying observations, and uncertainty-aware analysis.

contributions.title: Evidence-bounded problem formulation
contributions.statement: A governed comparator and claim boundary that places Antidote among prior closed-loop, current-to-target, controllable, physiologically adaptive, and longitudinal music systems without claiming those components as new.

contributions.title: End-to-end inspectability contract
contributions.statement: A person-and-moment model that preserves consented context, semantic intent, time-indexed planning, generated acoustic realization, exposure, perceived and felt response, usefulness or harm, aftereffect, and advisory updating as separately governed records.

contributions.title: Two-rate adaptive-audio architecture
contributions.statement: A proposed separation between an uncertain, person-correctable deliberative loop and a deterministic audio loop, with typed semantic mixins, receding-horizon planning, generate-ahead buffering, and independent semantic and waveform continuity checks.
contributions.status: proposed architecture; not implemented end to end

contributions.title: Human-authority and uncertainty model
contributions.statement: A local-first authority model in which context, proposals, generation, playback, retention, export, and personal-model updates remain consent-scoped, inspectable, interruptible, and human-correctable.
contributions.status: design contract with partially implemented mock evidence

contributions.title: Evidence-disciplined feasibility protocol
contributions.statement: A prospective evaluation and reporting contract that keeps intended control, acoustic adherence, perceived expression, felt response, immediate usefulness or harm, aftereffect, and clinical outcome distinct while retaining null, negative, missing, interrupted, and adverse observations.

stage_ladder.prohibited_claims: Human outcomes, clinical benefit, mechanism, or completion of proposed runtime behavior.

stage_ladder.permitted_claims: What the reviewed literature reports, what the repository implements, what the design formalizes, and what the protocol prospectively specifies.
stage_ladder.prohibited_claims: Any result that depends on an unrun protocol or unimplemented model capability.

stage_ladder.permitted_claims: Auditable technical checks and qualifying N-of-1 observations, each labeled at its actual evidence level.
stage_ladder.prohibited_claims: Generalized efficacy, clinical safety, universal mappings, or causal mechanism.

stage_ladder.permitted_claims: Only statements traceable to governed sources, reproducible repository evidence, or qualifying protocol observations.
stage_ladder.prohibited_claims: Peer-review, endorsement, DOI, clinical validation, or novelty beyond the bounded search.

terminology.definition: Shorthand for tailoring a proposal to one individual's present, consent-scoped moment, desired transition, explicit semantic language, exclusions, and relevant prior evidence. It is not a claim that the system knows the person's true state or uniquely invents moment-aware personalization.
The inspectable, user-authored combination of desired transition, semantic descriptors, inclusions, exclusions, and priorities that states what the person wants the journey to explore.
The governed progression represented by an accepted journey plan and its time-bounded stages; it is an intended audio experience, not proof of a state transition.
A typed, versioned, reversible semantic control object with a human-readable purpose, bounds, neutral position, exclusions, and adapter mapping; it is not undocumented prompt concatenation.
The versioned set of approved semantic and acoustic controls supplied to a model adapter for a bounded generation interval, including provenance, uncertainty, conflicts, and exclusions.
The audio artifact actually produced together with measured acoustic features and control-adherence estimates; requested or declared properties are not treated as realized until measured.
The recorded playback event through which the person actually encounters an audio artifact, including timing, completion, interruption, and stop or safety events.

A provenance-linked self-report, behavior, or optional measurement associated with an exposure. Perceived expression, felt state, usefulness, harm, and later aftereffect remain separate fields or observations.

The person's immediate appraisal of whether an exposure was helpful, neutral, mismatched, burdensome, distressing, or otherwise adverse in that moment; intensity and catharsis are not automatic proxies.
A response observation intentionally collected after the immediate session window at a declared interval and linked to the relevant exposure.

globally_prohibited: objective inference of a person's true emotion or need
guaranteed state transition or therapeutic benefit
specific neurological mechanism without qualifying evidence
synthetic fixture presented as human evidence

sections.purpose: Own document-level assembly, title metadata, bibliography, appendix boundary, and final build order.
required_evidence: Every included source has completed its owning issue.
Metadata agrees with beacon-project.toml and the claim ledger.
completion_criteria: The build order matches this contract.
Title, abstract, bibliography, and appendix render in both themes.
prohibited: A second manuscript source
Final title or abstract claims absent from the body

sections.purpose: Coordinate the canonical numbered section order without owning substantive prose.
required_evidence: All numbered section files exist and appear exactly once.
completion_criteria: Coordinator order matches the argument and this contract.
Conclusion is a dedicated final numbered section.
prohibited: Substantive duplicate manuscript prose

sections.purpose: Motivate the inspectability problem, state RQ1, bound RQ2 and RQ3, and preview only the accepted contribution combination.
required_evidence: Comparator matrix for the research gap
Claim ledger for thesis and contribution wording
Primary source records for any motivating empirical statement
completion_criteria: Problem, gap, questions, scope, and contributions agree with this contract.
The originating experience is hypothesis-generating only.
No broad novelty, efficacy, or mechanism language remains.
prohibited: Claim that personalization, semantic planning, or closed-loop generation is new
Promise that a mapping is learnable or beneficial

sections.purpose: Synthesize the closest systems and qualifying evidence by capability, evidence grade, disagreement, and remaining combination boundary.
completion_criteria: Every substantive comparison traces to an exact reviewed artifact.
Conflicting and null findings remain visible.
Search absence is described as bounded, never global.
prohibited: Citation counting as evidence strength
Architecture precedent presented as outcome evidence
Unqualified first-system language

sections.purpose: Formalize the person-moment model, inspectable record chain, two-rate architecture, semantic mixer, planning horizon, buffer, continuity, provenance, and failure boundaries.
required_evidence: Architecture evidence map and source records
planned_visuals: state estimation, receding horizon, and generate-ahead buffer
completion_criteria: Notation has one meaning and is dimensionally coherent.
Implemented, proposed, and unavailable behavior are visibly separated.
Every transferred formalism states what does not transfer.
prohibited: Person modeled as a controllable plant
Model estimate presented as true emotion
Crossfade presented as musical or emotional coherence
Unimplemented real-time generation claim

sections.purpose: Specify and freeze the prospective technical and N-of-1 feasibility protocol, measures, assignments, analysis, provenance, safety, and mutation rules.
required_evidence: Ethics, privacy, consent, exclusion, and stop decisions
completion_criteria: Variables, conditions, measures, assignments, exclusions, stopping, missingness, and analysis are reproducible.
Protocol versions and mutations are explicit.
Optional physiology never defines the person's state by itself.
prohibited: Retrospective protocol fitted to desired outcomes
Formal collection before ethics and safety gates
Clinical efficacy design language

sections.purpose: Provide a governed reporting structure for technical verification and later qualifying observations without populating unrun results.
required_evidence: Source record and provenance for every promoted result
Claim-ledger approval for technical evidence from MVP issue #18
planned_visuals: null, negative, missing, interrupted, and adverse outcomes
completion_criteria: The design/protocol manuscript states that no formal human results exist.
Every future slot declares its source, protocol, analysis, and evidence class.
Technical evidence is never labeled therapeutic.
prohibited: Synthetic fixture presented as observation
Originating catharsis presented as a formal result
Invented values or example statistics that resemble findings

sections.purpose: Interpret the framework and its evidence-bounded combination, compare plausible alternatives, and define falsifiable future directions.
completion_criteria: Interpretations remain proportional to the available evidence.
Alternative explanations and failure conditions are explicit.
Future directions identify the evidence needed to change a claim.
prohibited: Retroactive expansion of methods or results
Design elegance presented as empirical success
Feasibility presented as efficacy

sections.purpose: Audit validity, uncertainty, human risk, consent, privacy, licensing, accessibility, hearing safety, misuse, and actual ethics-review status.
required_evidence: Model, data, and generated-audio licensing records
completion_criteria: Mitigations and unresolved risks remain distinct.
Formal collection is not implied to be authorized.
Limitations constrain the Discussion and Conclusion.
prohibited: Local-first presented as perfect security
Provenance presented as truth, ownership, or consent
Absence of reported harm presented as safety

sections.purpose: State verified artifact availability, reproducibility boundaries, licensing, authorship, funding, acknowledgements, and conflicts.
required_evidence: Reviewed CRediT roles, licenses, funding, acknowledgements, and conflicts
completion_criteria: Every access statement resolves or states its exact status.
Private, sensitive, copyrighted, or unavailable material is not promised.
Manuscript, code, figures, sources, and model assets have distinct license boundaries.
prohibited: Unminted DOI or release
Institutional endorsement
Public availability of sensitive data

sections.purpose: Answer RQ1 at the design evidence level, summarize only supported contributions and limitations, and state the gates for RQ2 and RQ3.
completion_criteria: The conclusion answers only questions supported by the body.
The design/protocol contribution remains distinct from future feasibility evidence.
No new evidence or claim appears here first.
prohibited: Efficacy, mechanism, or clinical conclusion
New contribution absent from Introduction and Discussion
Future work stated as completed

sections.purpose: Preserve versioned protocol, analysis, provenance, and supporting material required to reproduce or audit the manuscript.
required_evidence: Supporting material cited from the body
planned_visuals: supporting protocol and evidence tables when needed
completion_criteria: Appendix material agrees with the canonical protocol and body.
Sensitive or unavailable material is excluded or access-controlled.
Every appendix artifact has an owning source and version.
prohibited: Unreviewed result hidden outside the Results section
Private participant or personal context
Alternative protocol presented as the frozen protocol

conclusion_decision.rationale: A dedicated conclusion makes the final claim boundary independently reviewable and prevents future directions in Discussion from becoming the manuscript's answer by implication.
